Using the Law of Sines, write
\[
\sin\alpha=\frac{a}{2R},\quad \sin\beta=\frac{b}{2R},\quad \sin\gamma=\frac{c}{2R}.
\]
Thus
\[
\cot\alpha+\cot\beta
=2R\left(\frac{\cos\alpha}{a}+\frac{\cos\beta}{b}\right),
\]
and
\[
\cot\gamma=\frac{2R\cos\gamma}{c}.
\]
So the target expression is
\[
\frac{\cot\gamma}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}
=
\frac{\frac{\cos\gamma}{c}}{\frac{\cos\alpha}{a}+\frac{\cos\beta}{b}}.
\]

By the Law of Cosines,
\[
\cos\alpha=\frac{b^2+c^2-a^2}{2bc},\qquad
\cos\beta=\frac{a^2+c^2-b^2}{2ac}.
\]
Hence
\[
\frac{\cos\alpha}{a}+\frac{\cos\beta}{b}
=
\frac{b^2+c^2-a^2+a^2+c^2-b^2}{2abc}
=
\frac{c}{ab}.
\]

Also, from \(a^2+b^2=1989c^2\),
\[
\cos\gamma=\frac{a^2+b^2-c^2}{2ab}
=
\frac{1988c^2}{2ab}
=
\frac{994c^2}{ab}.
\]
Therefore
\[
\frac{\cot\gamma}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}
=
\frac{\frac{\cos\gamma}{c}}{\frac{c}{ab}}
=
\frac{ab\cos\gamma}{c^2}
=
994.
\]

\[
\boxed{994}
\]
